facts.fact: maCERT, the DGSSI's cyber watch and response centre, issued a security warning bulletin (ref. 65471806/26) on the FortiBleed leak affecting Fortinet firewalls and SSL VPN gateways, saying several Moroccan institutions were affected and urging MFA and password changes.
maCERT is described as the DGSSI's centre for vigilance, monitoring and response to cyber attacks, operating under the National Defence Administration.
